propositions: Debug skill must write back RCA and reporting summary comments at four lifecycle points (Phase-1-exit, Reporting, not-a-bug classification, Step-7 siblings) with inline own-tracker vs third-party discriminator to prevent writebacks to unapproved external trackers.

Step-7 must perform two-axis sweep (construct pattern axis and parity-sibling axis joined by OR trigger) decomposed into four forced-artifact questions: NAME THE RULE, CHANNEL CENSUS (5-slot checklist), PER-SURFACE PROBE, and DISPOSITION.

Parity siblings are absences (parallel surfaces with different or missing implementations) that must be discovered without grep-visibility; Step-7's channel census must flag them via dual-direction and caller-set derivation.

Reporting must include residual-risk-and-prevention item with forced disposition (ticket filed, accepted with reason, or fixed in scope) per observed fragility, with 'none observed' as a legitimate value.
